text: Hi, I'm calling about the streetlights on my block. Three of them on North Fulton have been out for weeks and it is pitch black by the time people walk home from the bus.
The road outside my house is falling apart. The whole stretch is broken up, not just one pothole, and the school bus has to swing into the other lane to get around it.
Someone dumped a couch, a mattress, and a pile of construction debris in the alley behind East Chase Street. It has been sitting there since the weekend and the rats are all over it.
